title: Item:Yugoloth Favor Potions
wikitext:
{{Top}}__NOTOC__ Upon reaching the Unfriendly (75) [[The Yugoloth|Yugoloth Favor]], you can view and purchase Essence Potions by visiting [[Azdaf the Wary]] (Yugoloth Alchemist) in [[Amrath]]. These potions stack, up to 100 in your inventory for each of 6 different types. Each potion grants a buff to a stat and a unique extra bonus, but comes with an additional penalty.
